title: 5 easy diy last-minute Halloween costume ideas tutorial
description:
The last one is my favorite 😅

This Tutorial shows 5 easy and creative diy last-minute Halloween costumes that take under 5 minutes to make for anyone still in the need of a costume for Halloween!

They impress more with their creative names than with their effort 😅
Having a costume is still better than not having one. And explaining these costumes can also be a good conversation starter 😂

All the costumes require as little resources as possible, are very easy to make and work for both girls and guys as well as female and male wearers!

Let me know in the comments which costume is your favorite :)
  

I make more videos like this. Subscribe for more!
